name: BGZ - Bhagavad Gita for Gen Z

ios.desc:
BGZ - Bhagavad Gita for Gen Z is a Bhagavad Gita app built to make Krishna's teachings practical for everyday life.

This is a paid experience for readers who want a thoughtful, focused, and high-quality Gita app.

Inside the app:
- Complete Bhagavad Gita with all 18 chapters and 701 verses
- Clear, modern explanations designed for younger readers
- Daily reading support to build a consistent spiritual habit
- Fast verse lookup when you need perspective quickly
- Guidance on focus, purpose, discipline, and emotional balance

Why people choose it:
- To read Bhagavad Gita in a modern, practical format
- To apply Krishna's wisdom to school, work, relationships, and growth
- To reduce overthinking and make calmer decisions
- To keep a daily reading routine that feels simple and sustainable

We continue improving the experience with regular updates based on user feedback.
